_note: Behind-the-scenes clips: the dressing room, the travel, the warm-up, the daft stuff. Nothing here is a goal or a highlight; those are match footage and live on /videos.html against their match.
_where: THE FILES ARE NOT IN THIS REPOSITORY. A clip is several megabytes, git history is permanent, and one deleted a year later still weighs the same for everybody who clones. They go in the club's own Supabase storage bucket, the same one holding badges and article covers, and `src` is the public address of the uploaded file. /assets/video is allowed too, for anything short enough to be worth committing.
_instagram: A clip can instead carry only `instagram`, and the card then links out rather than playing. That is for a reel nobody wants to re-upload. A clip with both plays here AND links to the post.
_replaceWhen: Delete this file once the clips live in a database row the control panel writes. Until then the club cannot add one without a developer, which is a gap worth closing and is named on the page itself.
